arbeit-stoppen: Stops autonomous work safely when the researcher says stop.
auftrag-abarbeiten: Works through a queued job in rounds: log first, trial run on two cases, result file, self-check against the acceptance list.
aussenkontakt: Asks a question outside the machine through the exit guard, which blocks anything that refers to internal data.
bianca-wmh: Segments white matter hyperintensities on FLAIR with FSL BIANCA and a pretrained classifier, then thresholds, masks and reports volumes.
bianca-wmh-segmentation: Builds and runs a complete BIANCA pipeline, from DICOM to BIDS through preprocessing, training, inference and masking.
bias-korrektur: Corrects intensity inhomogeneity with FSL FAST or ANTs N4 and says which output image is the corrected one.
bids-konvertierung: Brings any data collection into a BIDS structure: DICOM folders, numbered directories, spreadsheet lists.
datenschutz: Rules for handling patient and institutional data on the machine; loaded whenever data sets or results are involved.
dicom-nach-nifti: Converts DICOM series to NIfTI with a JSON sidecar, checks the geometry and keeps patient identifiers out of the sidecar.
dicom-to-bids: Converts unstructured clinical DICOM exports into a valid BIDS data set, including the choice of series and duplicate detection.
eigener-stack: How the agent itself is run: llama.cpp with the local model on the workstation GPU as user services; for questions on speed, memory and restarts.
flywire-connectome: Turns FlyWire connectome data into a sparse PyTorch matrix.
fnirs-eeg-to-bids: Turns fNIRS, diffuse optical tomography and EEG recordings into valid BIDS data sets.
gewebe-segmentierung: Segments grey matter, white matter, CSF and ventricles with FreeSurfer SynthSeg and derives masks and volumes.
hirn-extraktion: Removes the skull with HD-BET on the CPU, with FSL BET or SynthStrip as fallback, and checks the brain mask.
laufstatus: Answers what is running: the state of jobs and projects.
lektionen: The 20 lessons of this machine in full: measure Dice per volume, never set a threshold on test data, build runs that can resume.
llama-log: Reads the model server log: time stamps, tokens per second, hours.
mb-arena: Runs the MicrobleedNet comparison on susceptibility-weighted images.
neuro-qc-report: Builds one self-contained HTML quality-control report for a set of brain MRI images: quality metrics, duplicates, slice montages with mask outlines.
neuro-qc-viewer: Builds an interactive browser viewer for brain MRI and segmentations with NiiVue: slices, underlays, overlays, thresholds.
neuroflow: A reusable Python library and conventions for neuroimaging pipelines with FSL and FreeSurfer.
nifti-pruefen: Checks and repairs NIfTI files: readable, same grid as the mask, orientation, voxel size, header.
papers: Downloads scientific papers on a topic as PDF from Europe PMC or arXiv.
pytorch: Builds, trains and tests PyTorch models on the workstation: U-Nets and other segmentation networks, classifiers, transformers.
selbstverbesserung: Self-improvement: read the own session, draw one lesson, make one change, measure it, version it.
voi-nach-nifti: Converts MRIcron .voi lesion masks to NIfTI and checks grid and label values.
wetter: Weather and forecast for any place through the Open-Meteo API.
wmh-vorverarbeitung: Runs and checks the complete preprocessing for WMH segmentation: brain extraction, bias correction, SynthSeg, registration, QC mosaic.
ziele-planen: Turns a one-sentence goal that needs hours of work into a chain of checked, queued jobs instead of working it off in the chat.
film-making: Makes a narrated animated film in Python: script, voice, chapters, checks, render, deliver folder.
install-from-zero-check: Tests a repository the way a new user meets it: fresh clone, new environment, installer, every README command.
mri-overlay-pages: Fixed colours and picture quality for MRI slices with masks: ground truth, second rater, true positive, false positive, false negative.
wiki-update: Adds what a finished task taught to the shared agent wiki, with sources, index line and log line.
alita-storage: Stores finished results and QC pages on the group drive and verifies them by checksums.
dataset-handover: Prepares an MRI data set for a collaborator: one folder per case, clear file names, file list, README, QC page.
explainer-video: Builds an animated, narrated explanation video from the real data of a task.
qc-page-building: Builds quality-control pages for MRI data with the house rules: overlay switch, methods box with software versions, hover explanations.
usage-feedback: Gives the researcher feedback on how they work with the setup assistant, from counts over their own sessions.
